meta.name: compact-guard
meta.description: Smart context compaction with state preservation. Saves critical files, task progress, and working state before compaction, restores after. Use before manual compact or when auto-compact triggers.

copy.tagline: 压缩上下文时自动保存和恢复工作状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在手动或自动压缩上下文时保留关键文件和进度
copy.tagline_en: Automatically save and restore working state during context compaction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to preserve critical files and progress when compacting context

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在压缩上下文前保存关键文件、任务进度和工作状态，压缩后自动恢复这些信息，确保重要内容不丢失。
howto.when: 当你手动执行 /compact 命令，或 Claude 自动触发上下文压缩时。

say.text: 保存当前任务状态，然后执行 /compact。
say.note: Claude 会先记录任务、文件、决策等，再压缩。

say.text: 压缩后恢复我正在编辑的文件。
say.note: Claude 会优先恢复你指定的工作文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude saves critical files, task progress, and working state before context compaction, then restores them after compaction to preserve important information.
howto.when_en: When you manually run /compact or when auto-compact triggers due to context window limits.

say_en.text: Save current task state, then run /compact.
say_en.note: Claude records task, files, decisions, then compacts.

say_en.text: Restore my working file after compaction.
say_en.note: Claude prioritizes restoring your active file.
